spec: phase0 s6 — stratified 20: 8 trap, 4 jersey club, 4 lo-fi, 4 pop-adjacent; mixed FL Studio/Ableton; 5-15 min preferred; prefer visible piano roll / step sequencer (feeds L2). 5 held out (1/genre + 1 extra trap) — the extractor and Monster NEVER see them during development.
selection_notes: Chosen via web search 2026-06-10 (titles/channels verified in results; durations and piano-roll visibility need a 30-second eyeball at sprint start — swap from the bench if one runs long or is talking-head-heavy). Stock-plugin and step-sequencer tutorials were preferred: they map cleanly onto Mosh builtins and produce strong L2 claims.
